rules.threshold_text: Applies by use (NAICS 518 or 519 except 519210, NAICS 522320 or 541214, or computational equipment in TVA's judgment), above 1,000 kW; four classes by the higher of on-peak or off-peak contract demand: TDCA over 1,000 kW up to 5,000 kW, TDCB over 5,000 kW up to 15,000 kW, TDCC over 15,000 kW up to 25,000 kW, TDCD over 25,000 kW (the large-load class, over 25 MW)
rules.contract_term: TDCA: initial term of at least 1 year, then year to year, terminable after the initial term on not less than 90 days' notice. TDCB, TDCC and TDCD: initial term of at least 5 years, renewals or extensions of at least 5 years; after 10 years of service a renewal or extension may provide for termination on not less than 16 months' notice
